title: The phone app
summary: The RetailOps app for iPhone and Android: the five tabs, scanning and labels, alerts, offline use and updates.

blocks.text: Install **KloudC RetailOps** from the App Store or Google Play (it shows as RetailOps under the icon). Sign in with the same Store ID, username and password as the website.

items: **Home**: the Today card, quick actions (Print labels, Upload invoice, Fix issues, New order, Daily Checklists) and your numbers.
**Store**: tap Ordering, Stock or Sales at the top and its tools list right below, on the same screen. It remembers your last choice.
**Scan**: scan a barcode to look an item up and print its price label. Search by name if a barcode won't scan.
**More**: your account (Notifications, Appearance, Face ID, Change password, Delete my account), Help & info, and Setup for admins.

blocks.text: Print label history (on Home, or the History icon on Scan) lists recent prints with Reprint. A print still in the printer's queue shows as still printing, not Printed.
A banner says you are offline. Screens you opened keep what they showed. A chat message that couldn't be sent stays with Not sent, tap to retry, and retrying never sends it twice.
Keep the app up to date from the App Store or Google Play. If the store needs a newer version for something to work, the app says so and links to the update.
The KloudC master console is on the website only. Typing Store ID PLATFORM in the app shows a link to it.
